data.one_liner: An efficient broadcast system for message sending, receiving, and state management in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: FBroadcast provides a broadcasting system allowing widgets and modules to communicate through messages, supporting sticky broadcasts, two-way communication, and context binding for easy unregistering.
use_when: You want complete decoupling between widgets or modules without using complex state managers.
You need sticky broadcasts that can be queued before a receiver is registered.
You need simple two-way communication between decoupled modules.
avoid_when: You prefer structured, predictable reactive state management architectures like Bloc or Riverpod.
Your project requires strict type safety for every message and payload.
strengths: Enables complete decoupling between widgets and modules.
Supports sticky broadcasts and two-way communication.
Context binding allows batch removal of receivers easily.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on string-based keys which can become difficult to maintain at scale.
Can make data flow harder to trace compared to explicit state containers.
